deploy-bot: CONFIG-ONLY rollout started: service=inference-config, release=v2024.11.2, change_window=2024-11-05T23:00Z..2024-11-06T01:00Z. Changes: rate limits (global qps), request timeout=4s -> 3s, routing policy tweak (prefer-dedicated fallback), batching: max_batch_size 16->32, batch_window_ms 10->25. Canary: 5% traffic, region=eu-west, monitoring hooks enabled. Auto-rollback: error_rate>1.0% OR p95_latency > +20% -> rollback to previous config. /cc @marta @hao @leah

marta: ack. quick Q — are we pinning model versions or just routing policy? I want to avoid any accidental cross-variant routing during the canary.

hao: we only changed routing policy and batching. pinned runtime routing to model-version "stable-1.9.2" for the canary; no model binary changes. Canary traffic is routed to dedicated pool with fallback to shared only if capacity exhausted.

leah: oncall here — saw a single spike on the last test run when batch_window_ms was 25ms in staging, timeout hit on a few 512-token requests. snippet from staging logs at 22:47:
```
2024-11-05T22:47:12Z inference-proxy[pid=1221]: request_id=ab12cd status=deadline_exceeded duration=3040ms p50=120ms p95=3100ms
```
I recommend we hold increasing batch_window_ms if p95 moves up. what's our rollback plan timing if things go bad?

ravi: rollback plan: immediate pin back to v2024.11.1 config via config-service endpoint and abort ramp. Ops runbook: alert -> 5min investigation -> if >1% errors/20% p95 increase persistent for 2 consecutive minutes -> rollback. I can run the rollback if needed.

deploy-bot: Canary update (5m): canary_traffic=5%, samples=12k, error_rate=0.6%, p95_latency_change=+8% (baseline p95 210ms -> 227ms). No increased throttles in dedicated pool. Observability: traces show slightly larger batch assembly times but overall token throughput improved. No capacity fallbacks observed.

marta: thanks. numbers look okay. leaning to proceed with cautious ramp to 30% over next 15m, monitor closely. keep the timeout at 3s for now but watch 95th. @leah please ping if you see timeout >0.9% or p95 delta >12%.

hao: starting ramp -> set canary -> 30% over 15m, will push progressive weights (5->15->30). I'll keep an eye on queueing metrics and batch sizes.

leah: copy. will watch, will alert at threshold. :eyes:

ravi: noted. ops on standby, rollback hot path ready. :thumbsup:
